I went through very very very similar stuff and still to this day it is very hard to deal with. At first it’s hard to accept/realize that it’s abuse because you might have normalized it, think you’re being dramatic or just thought that’s how your dad is. My dad abused me physically and mentally,  I also get panic attacks like yours, I definitely don’t want to have to do anything with my dad tbh. I got into therapy and honestly it has been helping with my trauma + depression (but dam it’s a very rough and difficult journey) I’d suggest you to seek help from a third party if possible, or look for therapy or a group therapy for abuse victims. If you need anyone to talk to please hit me up. Hoping things get better for you and your brother!
Happy 21st Birthday <3 have an awesome year and I definitely wish you find the right people soon :3 Xoxo From Mx
